streaming_input.text: First, note whether both devices lose service together and check the router lights during a
drop. Then check power plugs and visible cable condition without unplugging anything, and
stop if anything looks wet, scorched, hot, or damaged.
If its existing cables reach safely, place the router upright on an open, elevated
shelf outside the cupboard and away from metal. Test coverage there, then consider a
compatible plug-in mesh unit if needed, without drilling.
